string.text: Path to a Freebooter
To prove yourself as a Freebooter, you must complete the quests of 5 different villages and reach a total relation of {REQUIRED_RELATION}+ with the villagers.
Completed Different Village Quests
Total Relation with Villagers
You have completed a quest for {VILLAGE_NAME}. ({CURRENT}/5)
Your renown grows among the common folk. Total notable relation: {RELATION}/{REQUIRED}
Path to a Bannerman
To ascend to nobility as a Bannerman, you must persuade {REQUIRED_PERSUASIONS} different lords to recognize you as a noble.
Persuaded Lords
{LORD_NAME} has acknowledged your nobility. ({CURRENT}/{REQUIRED})
Path to a Chieftain
You must defeat and capture {REQUIRED_CAPTURES} different lords on the battlefield. You must also release {REQUIRED_RELEASES} high-ranking noble in exchange for their recognition of your nobility.
Captured Lords
Released Nobles
You have defeated and captured {LORD_NAME}. ({CURRENT}/{REQUIRED})
You released a noble and gained their recognition. Points: {CURRENT}/{TARGET}
Path to a Count
To prove yourself as a Count, you must either conquer a castle or successfully defend your own castle against a siege.
Conquered or Defended Castle
You have raised your banners over a conquered castle. Your might is undeniable.
The castle walls held strong under your command. You have proven yourself a capable defender of the realm.
Path to a Duke
To declare your might as a Duke across the realm, you must capture the sovereign of 2 different kingdoms in battle.
Captured Sovereigns
The sovereign {RULER_NAME} of {KINGDOM_NAME} now kneels before you. The realm trembles. ({CURRENT}/2)
Path to a Sovereign
To be crowned as the High Emperor (Sovereign) of Calradia, you must forge a kingdom holding at least {REQUIRED_TOWNS} great towns and {REQUIRED_CASTLES} castles.
Owned Towns
Owned Castles
From peasant to Emperor, you have forged a mighty kingdom with {REQUIRED_TOWNS} great towns and {REQUIRED_CASTLES} unyielding castles. All of Calradia will know your name!
I don't speak with peasants. Watch your tone, or I'll have to put you in your place.
As you wish.
My {?CONVERSATION_NPC.GENDER}Lady{?}Lord{\?}, I believe I have proven myself. I ask that you recognize me and my clan as Nobility.
I advise you not to anger me. We do not consider every vagabond a noble. Leave me be!
Very well. Tell me, what makes you worthy of this honor?
My {?CONVERSATION_NPC.GENDER}Lady{?}Lord{\?}, my name is spoken with reverence in the surrounding villages. The breath of the people is my breath.
For me, both gold and word have a standard. The reputation of an honest merchant crosses borders.
When my name is heard on the battlefields, hearts find courage. My brothers-in-arms would walk blindly to their deaths for me.
War is a board, and I always play my pieces for victory. No trap surprises me.
The land belongs not only to the one who sows it, but to the one who protects it. An order where justice reigns is my doing.
I do not hesitate to walk in the shadows and dirty my hands when necessary. I even have a place in the nightmares of my enemies.
The one who will bend my wrist in a one-on-one fight has not yet been born. The art of war is my purest nature.
I always know a way to overcome the supposedly indestructible walls and shatter the impenetrable armor. Intellect is always superior to brute force.
Mercy is the greatest power. When my warriors are wounded, their hope is my healing hands.
I suppose you're right. You have proven your worth. You are a noble of Calradia now.
This is nonsense. Do not waste my time with this again.
Fair point. You may really be eligible.
I don't think so. Not noble manners at all.
Is that all? Keep on. I'm still considering.
I will release you on one condition. Recognize me and my clan as a Chieftain, and you will have your freedom.
At least I won't have been captured by a lower-class peasant. I accept.
Send word to your clan. When they declare they recognize me, you will be released.
I am at your mercy, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}!
You will die before you ever become a Chieftain. Eventually, I will hold your head in my hands. Get lost, you lower-class scum!
I remind you that you are at my mercy. Tell your clan to prepare a generous ransom.
I will kill you, you will die!
You cannot gain more renown! Check the Quests tab to see how to ascend to {TIER_NAME}.
Why are you taking my precious time, peasant?! I hope its important.
There's no way, I'm planning to discuss something with a filthy peasant. Know your place!
I have no intention of giving this task to a peasant of unknown origin.
My men also does not recognize you or your clans name. Which means that you are not even a Bannerman.
Demands...? Are you okay? You must've hit your head somewhere. A peasant demands something from me, eh?
I hope thats all. I'm not willing to spend one more second with a peasant after all!
Yes, off with you. Frankly, you should have vanished from my sight long before this.
You dare bargain with me? Let's hear what you have to say.
I'm still listening. Go on.
I could execute you right now. Instead, I offer life. A wise lord knows the value of my mercy.
Think of your clan. An alliance with me is more profitable than dying in a dungeon.
Honor dictates that a life spared must be repaid with respect.
Release means we are equals. Tell your kin that I am a chieftain worthy of their respect.
Don't let foolish pride blind you. A rational lord recognizes a new power when he sees it.
I have your life in the palm of my hand. Validate me, and you keep it.
You make a fair point. Proceed.
I am not convinced by such words.
I have bled on the field, calculated every maneuver, and kept my honor intact. A true lord respects these above all.
For me, both gold and word have a standard. The reputation of an honest merchant crosses borders.
My word is my bond. My name is spoken with reverence in the surrounding villages.
A true ruler protects the weak, feeds the hungry, and keeps his oaths. This is what makes me worthy.
The one who will bend my wrist in a fair fight has not yet been born.
War is a board, and I always play my pieces for victory. No trap surprises me.
I bring courage to the line, wisdom to the council, and spoils to my followers. What else does nobility require?
The land belongs not only to the one who sows it, but to the one who protects it.
I do not hesitate to walk in the shadows and dirty my hands when necessary. I am my enemy's nightmare.
Ascension Quest
Your clan has been recognized and ascended to the next tier!
Perhaps you should try this offer on prisoners with whom you have a better relationship (Relation >= 7).
